text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, how've things been lately? Getting 
your daily dose of heart-throbs~?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Geez, stop wording things in a way that 
causes misunderstandings!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You mean the movies, right? On my days 
off, I try to go see one whenever I can.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And after that... Head over to your usual 
haunt and complain over drinks?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Even the other day, you went on and on 
about how that new movie you were looking 
forward to was such a letdown... Sounds 
like you had plenty to say about it, 
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, really?! ...I see, the cafe 
Master told you, didn't he?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"You haven't shown your face around here 
lately, yet... you still manage to dig up 
all the juicy gossip."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Does that mean... something like "I 
haven't chatted with Maruzen-san lately, 
and it's mega uncool~"?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Aww, you're too sweet♪ Hold on, I'll clear 
my schedule in a flash!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So... tell me about that heart-throbbing 
story, the one that wasn't a 
misunderstanding♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I told you, there's nothing going on 
there! Haven't I been saying that all 
along? —Right now, I am completely devoted 
to my work!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You say that~, but aren't you just being 
secretive? There's no running away this 
time, got it?♪
